ops.en: THE CLEARING. ve-lo yakhol yosef LE-HITAPEQ — the restrain-verb of 43:31 (its one Torah token) fails in the negative: the mask's engine stops; HOTZIU khol ish mealai — the clearing-order pushed.

POPPED IN PLACE. ve-lo amad ish ito — no man stood with him: the order discharges inside its own verse (the same-verse class of the creation grammar); be-HITVADA yosef — the make-known verb: the recognize-root's final conjugation — gen_60's haker-na file closes in reflexive.

THE SEAM THE PREVIOUS UNIT DECLARED OPEN IS CLOSED AT THIS VERSE. gen_67's operators broke off mid-speech by design, and the standing reading of that speech runs exactly 'until Joseph could not restrain himself' - our first clause. The recorded dispute travels with it: one master holds the room should not have been cleared, since a single kick would have killed him; another holds it was proper, th…

THE THIRD WEEPING. va-yiten et QOLO bi-vkhi — the weep-series' third station and its loudest: the chamber (43:30) could hold it; now Egypt hears and Pharaoh's house hears — the mask ends acoustically before it ends verbally.

THE UNMASKING. ANI YOSEF — two words end three units of machinery; ha-OD AVI CHAI — the still-alive question rehearsed at 43:27 in the mask's voice now asked in his own (the readings hear the rebuke in it, named); ve-lo yakhlu... ki NIVHALU — the terror-verb: the speech Judah built is answered by a sentence no one can answer. gen_67's substitution-demand meets this verse as its off-queue answer (t…

THE JUDGMENT-DAY ARGUMENT, MINTED HERE AND WITNESSED TWICE [claim G68-23; middah I1]. If the youngest of the tribes rebuked them and they could not answer, how much more the rebuke of Heaven. A second authority states it independently and harder - he was flesh and blood; the Holy One is judge, litigant and bench at once. Two sections, one rule, kept as two witnesses rather than folded into a dupli…
THE DRAW-NEAR RETURNED. GESHU-NA elai — Judah's own approach-verb (va-yigash, 44:18) handed back as an invitation;

AND THEY DREW NEAR. va-yigashu — popped in place (the span's second same-verse discharge); asher MEKHARTEM oti — the sale said aloud for the first time since 37:28: the record the brothers kept from the father is spoken by its victim.

IDENTITY PROVED ON THE BODY [claim G68-24]. 'Come near to me, and they came near' is read as showing them the circumcision - the proof physical and covenantal at once, offered to men who had just been told a thing they could not believe. The three titles of the next verses are parsed in the same passage as a patron to the king, a lord of the house, and a ruler of the land. [folded shape: kept reco…

THE PARDON [G67-04 CLOSED]. ve-AL YICHAR be-enekhem — the let-it- not-burn phrase's second and last Torah token: Judah begged it of the judge (44:18); the judge grants it to the guilty — the adjacency census closes inside the cycle. ki LE-MICHYA shelachani ELOHIM — the plot's theology from its subject: the steward said it slant (43:23), the brothers said it in terror (42:28), Joseph says it as ver…

THE SUSPENDED HARVEST [G68-01]. en charish VE-QATZIR — the harvest- word stands exactly TWICE in the Torah: the covenant's 'seed and HARVEST shall not cease' (8:22, the flood's own standing invariant in gen_20's span) and this 'no plowing and HARVEST' [VERIFIED: manifest G68-01] — and the Kitzur reconciles the collision himself (named): the decree does not break the covenant — what is sown will be…

THE REMNANT. la-sum lakhem SHEERIT — the remnant-word (the prophets' great term) enters the Torah's mouth-space here; li-fleta gedola — the deliverance-word of Lot's escape (19:17's escape-verb family): the sale re-typed as rescue infrastructure.

THE INVERSION. LO ATEM shelachtem oti hena KI HA-ELOHIM — the plot's agency formally transferred: the machine notes the brothers' deed stands in the record (37:28, 45:4 mekhartem) while its meaning is re-typed — deed unerased, verdict rewritten; u-MOSHEL be-khol eretz mitzrayim — the rule-word of the sheaves-quarrel (37:8 mashol timshol) spoken plain by the ruled-over's brother.

THE MESSAGE [G68-04]. MAHARU va-ALU el avi — the go-up demand pushed on the brothers, carrying an inner demand on the father: REDA elai — 'come DOWN to me': the come-down word stands ONCE in the Torah [VERIFIED: manifest G68-04]; Scripture's pair is Ezekiel's descent- order to Pharaoh's own house ('go down, be laid with the uncircumcised', Ezek 32:19, named — the Kitzur weighing exile against the …
GOSHEN. ve-yashavta be-eretz GOSHEN — the district named before Pharaoh ratifies it (47:6 will confirm): the son plans the father's geography; qarov ELAI — the nearness-clause is the offer's heart.

THE SUSTAINING. ve-KHILKALTI otkha sham — the sustain-verb (the ravens' verb at Cherith is its Prophets-echo, named): the son pledges the father's bread; pen TIVARESH — the impoverish-word (its Proverbs pair on sleep and poverty, named by the Kitzur with the torn-garments homily): want is the only threat left standing.

THE SEEING EYES [G68-07]. ve-ene achi BINYAMIN — written FULL: the seven-full census's sixth station (G65-02) — full at the SEEING (as at the naming, the guarding, the sending, the greeting, the blessing) while the weeping-necks verse two lines down writes him LEAN twice (45:14, asserted): full when witnessed, lean when wept on; the printed variance-list's Ben Asher/Ben Naphtali note at 45:14 is R…

THE SECOND PROOF OF IDENTITY IS THE TONGUE, AND BOTH MEMBERS WRITE IT [claim G68-24]. The chain reads 'my MOUTH is speaking to you' as speaking in the holy tongue; Onkelos states it outright - that I speak to you IN YOUR LANGUAGE. Where the previous clause offered the body, this one offers the language, and the translation and the midrash arrive at it independently. [folded shape: dual-track trans…

THE JOY BRING-DOWN [G67-06 CLOSED]. u-mihartem VE-HORADTEM et avi hena — the bring-down verb's third and last Torah token: the father dreaded it twice into Sheol (42:38, 44:29); the sons receive it once as a command into Goshen — the census closes with the verb converted. ve-HIGADTEM — the tell-verb full (the G65-06 law: only the well and the still-lives carry it lean).

THE NECKS [G68-02]. va-yipol al TZAVRE vinyamin achiv va-YEVK — weeping station four, the first reciprocal one (u-vinyamin BAKHA al TZAVARAV); and the neck-word TZAVARAV opens its four-token Torah file: the kid-skins on Jacob's DECEIVING neck (27:16 — the deception's prop), Benjamin's neck here, and the father-reunion pair (46:29 twice, ARMED) [VERIFIED: manifest G68-02]: the neck that deceived a …

TWO SANCTUARIES PRICED AT ONE LETTER, ON A FORM WITH NO SECOND SEAT [claim G68-21, machine-checked]. Did Benjamin have two necks? The plural is read as the two Temples destined for his portion and destined to fall, with Benjamin weeping in return over the sanctuary at Shiloh in Joseph's portion. Machine-checked: NINE neck-tokens in the whole Torah, and this construct-plural stands EXACTLY ONCE, he…

THE HEALED SPEECH. ve-achare khen DIBRU echav ITO — the span's quietest crown: gen_60 opened with 'they could NOT speak to him in peace' (37:4, ve-lo yakhlu dabro le-shalom); the cycle's wound closes in the same grammar — his brothers SPOKE with him: the machine files the two verses as the corpus's longest repaired clause (twenty-two years, nine units).

THE LEAN VOICE [G68-03]. ve-ha-QOL nishma — the voice-word written LEAN (the Masorah's pair: Ezra's shout at the rebuilding 'the voice was heard afar' FULL — first lean, second full; 'the secret of the matter is in the Zohar', named as MS himself names it): the skeleton's other Torah token is Jethro's 'they will LIGHTEN from you' (Exod 18:22) — a homograph collision framed, not claimed [VERIFIED: …

THE CORPUS NAMED THIS VERSE BEFORE IT DERIVED THIS BLOCK [claim G68-29]. The previous group's ledger cited a typology at 41:38 and recorded in writing that its home verse was here, to be read at Vayigash. It arrives at home, mounted on the news reaching the palace, its duplicate pair now seated at both ends. [folded shape: kept record]

THE KING'S DO-THIS. ZOT ASU — Pharaoh takes up the formula Joseph coined at the trial (42:18) and Jacob at the caravan (43:11): the third do-this closes the set (governor, father, king); u-LEKHU under the maqqef, not the lengthening-stroke (MS, asserted [G68-13]): the go-word joined to its going.

THE ROYAL SUMMONS. u-QCHU et avikhem... u-VOU ELAI — Pharaoh's come- demand: pushed on the brothers, aimed at the father — the queue's forward hook (the arrival, 46:6-7 and 47:1-6 in waiting, ARMED for the next units); et TUV eretz mitzrayim... CHELEV ha-aretz — the good and the fat: the king's vocabulary of welcome (and the readings' long memory of what Egypt's fat later cost, named-only).

THE WAGONS [G68-09]. QECHU lakhem me-eretz mitzrayim AGALOT — the wagon-order pushed; ve-ATA TZUVETA — 'and you are commanded' with the command-verb written FULL to its final he ('for the homily, as the Zohar reads it' — MS naming the source, named) [asserted]; the wagon-word begins the count the reading tradition sets against the broken-necked calf of the last parting (the calf-rite of Deut 21, n…

THE UNSPARING EYE [G68-05]. ve-ENKHEM al TACHOS — the your-eye word written with its second yod LEAN: one of the Masorah's matched pairs (the full twin stands in the garden's 'your eyes will be opened', per the Ramah's rule as MS quotes it) — this exact form ONCE in Scripture [VERIFIED: manifest G68-05]; TACHOS lean vav with the precise books against the rest of the Torah's full spellings (asserte…

THE RECEIPT. va-YAASU KHEN bene yisrael — the ken-clause receipts the wagon-order; AL PI FARO — by the mouth of Pharaoh: the wagons carry the king's authorization in their axles (the phrase the readings weigh against the mouth that speaks, 45:12); pharaoh's pe soft at the join (MS, asserted [G68-13]).

THE CHANGES [G68-06]. CHALIFOT semalot... CHAMESH CHALIFOT semalot — the change-of-garments word stands in the Torah ONLY in this verse, and twice with two spellings: the first FULL (chalifot), the second LEAN (chalifot without its vav) — each its only token; the Hilleli's first reading is our books' (the Yerushalmi leans both, named) [VERIFIED: manifest G68-06]. The garment-code closes GIVING: st…

THE TRAIN [G68-11]. asara CHAMORIM... ve-eser ATONOT noset — the she-ass word lean-of-lean and its carrying-word lean (the Ramah's double-lean rule; the Chronicles full partner named) [asserted]; u-MAZON — the sustenance-word: TWICE in Scripture, here and Daniel's 'food for all' (named by the Kitzur): the son feeds the father as the empire-tree feeds all flesh [VERIFIED: manifest G68-12].

A RULE FOR VOWS TAKEN FROM A DONKEY-LOAD OF PROVISIONS [claim G68-25]. In vows one follows COLLOQUIAL SPEECH, so each of the three words keeps its plain sense; and from 'food' here it is derived that all foodstuffs fall under the term. Recorded against it, and not suppressed, is a named authority's own contrary usage - having eaten boiled grain he would say he had not eaten food that day. The rule…

THE LAST ORDER [G68-13]. AL TIRGEZU ba-darekh — the do-not-quarrel pushed as the caravan leaves: the negative-demand class (no receipt follows; the road keeps its own counsel) — and the reading tradition triples its sense (do not blame; do not stop for rulings on the way; do not stride too far — the Kitzur's letter-counts, named): the gimel dageshed in-stream (checked).

PRACTICAL LAW EXTRACTED FROM A FAREWELL [claim G68-26]. Do not take long strides; do not break off from study; enter the city while the sun still shines. Onkelos gives the verb as do not be troubled or QUARREL along the way - the sense those rules assume, a warning about conduct between travellers rather than about fear. [folded shape: dual-track translation]

THE ASCENT [G68-08]. va-YAALU mi-mitzrayim — the go-up demand discharges (and gen_67's open dismissal — 'go up in peace to your father', 44:17 — finally happens too, with all twelve alive on the board: the corpus settlement link carries it); va-yavou ERETZ kenaan — the bare 'land of Canaan' where readers presume the directional 'to-the-land': one of the Masorah's FIVE presumed-but-not-written case…

THE LEAN TELLING [G65-06 CLOSED]. va-YAGIDU lo — the tell-verb LEAN: the second and last of the Ramah's two lean tellings (the well found, 26:32; the son found, here) — the census armed at gen_65 closes at its own station [VERIFIED under G65-06; the token asserted in-stream]; the Kitzur reads the clipped yod as the clipped telling: they could not tell it whole until the ban of the ten was released…

THE BLOODIED TUNIC IS PAID FOR AT THIS VERSE [claim G68-22 context]. The rule is stated flatly: the liar's penalty is that even when he speaks the truth he is not believed - and here the brothers, telling the truth at last, are not believed. Onkelos specifies what failed: not the organ but the faculty, THE WORDS CREATED UNCERTAINTY in his heart, the same move the buffer made on the failing heart a…

THE REVIVAL. va-yar et HA-AGALOT... va-TECHI ruach yaaqov — the wagons carry the proof the words could not: the reading tradition counts the portion's four wagon-tokens against the four broken- necked-calf tokens of the last law the father taught the son (the calf-rite, Deut 21 — the sign between them, named): the letter-count as password. va-techi RUACH — the spirit-word's first revival since it …

A CIPHER BETWEEN FATHER AND SON, CHECKED AT BOTH ENDS [claim G68-22, machine-checked]. The wagons are read as a sign: the last passage they studied together was the beheaded heifer, and the two words differ by a vowel. Machine-checked: the wagon-word stands at SEVEN Torah seats, FOUR in this parashah's own units and three in the tribal-prince donation; the heifer-word at five, FOUR of them in the …

THE RESOLVE. RAV — 'enough': one word closes twenty-two years of mourning (the readings hear the whole sentence in it, named); od yosef BENI chai — the still-lives clause now with MY SON restored to it; ELKHA ve-erenu be-terem amut — the father's counter-demand on himself: the going-down the next unit performs (46:1, ARMED). The narrator seals the verse with ISRAEL — the covenant name carries the …

ONE WORD, AND BOTH MEMBERS DECLINE THE OBVIOUS READING [claim G68-28]. The chain hears GREATNESS - the greatness of my son, who kept his righteousness through more troubles than I bore. Onkelos hears JOY - there is great joy for me. Neither takes it as 'it is too much.' The disagreement is not about what the verse means but about which of two better meanings it carries.
